items.label: MA-AG civil: FedEx Ground
items.detail: Settlement of AG claims that FedEx Ground misclassified its Massachusetts drivers as independent contractors, resolving a 2007 citation under appeal; date is the announcement date. Release states FedEx Ground pays more than $3 million to the Commonwealth's general fund (stated floor; includes payments for underpaid payroll taxes, workers' compensation and unemployment assistance, plus a payment to 13 named drivers) and denies liability.
